purpose: Compare Jev and Gemini on pinned v11 relevance under identical monolithic semantics, then evaluate a separately calibrated provider-neutral atomic architecture without tuning on v11.

known_prior_exposure.details: Historical Jev aggregate precision, recall, controls, and some error context from v11 have been observed. They may define historical gates but must not be used to edit candidate prompts.

models.availability_evidence: Successful historical v11 relevance calls and the pinned JEV_EXECUTION_POLICY adapter constant.
OpenRouter endpoint inventory returned active Google and Google AI Studio endpoints on 2026-09-19: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/google/gemini-2.5-flash/endpoints
OpenRouter endpoint inventory returned active Google and Google AI Studio endpoints on 2026-09-19: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/google/gemini-3.8-flash/endpoints

availability_rule: Before a paid run, abort rather than substitute if a requested model has no active endpoint or the provider reports a different actual model. Record the endpoint response as run evidence.

held_out_source.selection: All and only manifest cases whose concern is relevance, in manifest order.

operational_amendments.reason: The first live Gemini pass had 0/1044 completed cases. Strict JSON with a 64-token completion cap produced truncated or schema-violating content. The provider-neutral question, state, threshold, and model IDs are unchanged; only the Gemini transport now forces a probability function call and permits 1024 completion tokens.

protocol_deviations.rule: Atomic-policy calibration was to remain blind to v11 per-case outputs until the final atomic policy digest was frozen.
protocol_deviations.deviation: The completed monolithic analysis listed stable false-positive, false-negative, and unstable v11 case IDs before atomic calibration began.
protocol_deviations.consequence: The atomic policy must still be frozen using only the prospective disjoint calibration set, but any later atomic v11 result is non-blind exploratory evidence rather than a confirmatory held-out result. A new disjoint post-freeze holdout is required for confirmatory evidence.

atomic_policy.architecture_contract: Provider-neutral binary questions decompose Relevance V3 context and impact semantics; arithmetic and boolean composition remain deterministic code; every model receives identical semantics and a local 0.5 threshold.
atomic_policy.architecture_contract_digest_method: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 architecture_contract text
atomic_policy.registration_rule: After calibration, append the selected question and composition digests plus rejected alternatives to this file before any atomic v11 call. Changing them after that amendment creates a new experiment identity.

calibration.contamination_finding: v10 and v11 share all 174 relevance cases. Earlier releases are ancestors. The later v12 material adds no relevance labels. None may be used for calibration.
calibration.source_protocol: Prospectively select article versions from reports after 2026-09-11. Freeze article version ID, material digest, canonical URL, publication time, report ID, and feedback provenance before labeling.
calibration.overlap_rule: Exclude any article version ID, material digest, canonical URL, or feedback ID appearing in v11. Persist the complete overlap-check output with the calibration manifest.
calibration.selection_rule: Review eligible articles chronologically until both relevance classes contain at least 10 examples or 40 articles have been reviewed. Freeze every reviewed article and exclusion; do not discard difficult labels.
calibration.labeling_rule: A human labels monolithic relevance and every candidate atomic question from the registered semantics without seeing model output. A second human resolves ambiguous labels before model calls.
calibration.separation_rule: Calibration cases are never reported as held-out performance and v11 per-case outputs remain unread until the atomic policy digest is frozen.

monolithic_run.resume_rule: Resume only an exact identity match. Preserve failed attempts; --retry-errors may rerun only operational-error cases.
monolithic_run.inspection_rule: Do not inspect any fresh paired result until all registered targets and trials have either completed or reached the registered operational stop.

analysis.intervals: Report two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for precision, recall, and positive-control preservation per target and trial.
analysis.paired_analysis: For each target pair, report the 2x2 correctness disagreement table and a two-sided exact McNemar binomial p-value. Report effect counts before p-values.
analysis.stability: For each target and case, report unanimous verdict rate across three trials, flip count, and probability range. Report stable false-positive/false-negative IDs and boundary cases whose verdict changes.
analysis.aggregation: Report each trial separately plus pooled descriptive totals. Repeated trials are not independent samples.
analysis.missingness: Operational failures are coverage failures, are excluded from quality denominators, and are reported by attempt status and target. No quality comparison is valid below 100% completed-case coverage.

gates.coverage: Every target must complete all 174 relevance cases in every trial with validated accounting.
gates.quality: Every trial must preserve all positive controls, have recall = 1.0, and precision >= 0.80.
gates.selection: A target that fails coverage or quality is not deployment-eligible. Among eligible targets, report the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier; do not collapse it to an unsupported single winner.

budget.forecast_method: Assume 6,000 input and 64 output/reasoning tokens for each of 174 cases, three trials, and one call per case. Apply 0.042 USD/M Jev input tokens, active standard OpenRouter rates of 0.30/2.50 USD/M input/output for Gemini 2.5 Flash and 0.75/3.75 USD/M for Gemini 3.8 Flash, then add 25% retry contingency.
budget.stop_rule: Stop scheduling new calls before projected cumulative cost exceeds the hard cap. Preserve completed evidence and preregister a larger budget before resuming. Atomic calibration and atomic v11 work require separate budgets in the digest amendment.
